sourceRefs.locator: No. 9, p. 22, c. 12, and p. 23, final subscription and dating clause. Judges from other provinces or regions, restitution from their own goods, and Paris as the place of issue.
BK 9, Date and Transmission. Editions by Pertz and Boretius date the edict to 18 October 614. Manuscript Berlin, Staatsbibliothek, Phill. 1743.
Attestation 1173. Closing clause of the edict of Chlothar II, issue at Paris in 614.

note.de: Die Ortsangabe verortet die Ausstellung auf Stadtebene.
note.en: The place name locates the issue of the edict at city scale.

note.de: Paris steht in der Schlussformel des königlichen Edikts als Ausstellungsort.
note.en: The dating clause names Paris as the place where the king issued the edict.
